Quantas empresas deixaram de pagar IRC em Pt e passaram para a Holanda e para outros paises com uma fiscalidade mais simpática?

Isto para não falar na questão moral de que eu arrisco, produzo e alguém fica com o dinheiro.

Boa analise. Concordo com quase tudo excepto a ultima. O crescimento das capacidades de AI é uma curva exponencial. 18 months is a long time. Nao vai fazer dent na inflacao e na produtividade no contexto actual (humanos a usar AI). O contexto vai alterar (AI, incluindo física, a produzir autonomamente)

There are 2 issues I have with this:

1) debt to gdp ratio is 2 to 3 times higher than before, interest payments as a share of gdp will be way higher.

2) if you get serious about fixing the deficit, you might trigger a recession and there goes the grow our way out of it narrative.

Right now, it seems that we could grow our way out of it, but that is in part because our average rate is still 3.5% (increasing every month). As the older bonds roll over and new debt takes higher interest we might come to the realization that it won't be possible.

This is one of the reasons, I think, Bessent is trying to finance in the short end of the curve while trying to get the FED to lower rates... that would buy us some time and let us grow a bit more, but no one knows exactly what will happen.
